kind: immutable selection and specification batch; NOT fitted-model export
status: selection pinned; holder-ready numeric exports and fresh-test deposit pending

settings.null_pert: per-perturbation scalar of a candidate proportional to a parent column permuted within bins of the targets' mean control expression, parent columns in place
